_comment: Class drip emails, uploaded to SendGrid by scripts/upload-sendgrid-templates.mts.
The HTML here is the SOURCE OF TRUTH — edit it, re-run the script, and SendGrid
gets a new version. Editing in SendGrid's UI instead means the next upload
silently overwrites your change, so make edits here.
`slug` must match the class slug in the manifest Sheet exactly. Note 4a: the
class the audience knows as 'Class 4' has manifest slug '4a', and there is no
class '4' — /class/4 renders 'we couldn't find that class'.
`subject` is what the recipient sees in their inbox. SendGrid does not derive
